attach_file.description: Loads one file into context by persistent ID or a folder-rooted project path.
rules: For project files, prefer the visible folder-rooted path exactly as project_tree/project_search return it (for example jin_core/src/main.py). The attached folder ID is an ASSET_ACTION selector, not a file-path root. With one attached folder, old plain relative paths remain accepted for compatibility; old ID-prefixed paths are also accepted but should not be generated. Persistent file IDs still work. Optional #Lstart-Lend selects inclusive lines (default 200, max 400; 24000 characters; UTF-8 up to 1 MiB).
Loaded source is nested inside that ATTACH_FILE result as FILE_CONTENT. An already-loaded file fails; DETACH_FILE first to reread or change its range. Batch independent markers in one message.
